nodes.description: Private uint256 holding the secret number to guess; set by shuffle().
Public uint256 timestamp of the last play() call, used by kill() timing gate.
Public uint256 minimum bet price (0.001 ether) checked in play().
Public address of the contract owner, set from msg.sender in the constructor and used in kill().
Public Game[] array accumulating every bet (player address and guessed number).
Constructor: sets ownerAddr = msg.sender and calls shuffle() to seed secretNumber.
Internal function that derives secretNumber from sha3(now, block.blockhash(block.number-1)) % 10 + 1 (weak randomness).
Payable public function that records a bet and transfers the whole balance to msg.sender on a correct guess.
Public function that self-destructs the contract if msg.sender is the owner and 6 hours have passed since lastPlayed.
Payable fallback function accepting plain ether transfers.
Caller-controlled address used for owner assignment, bet recording, payout destination and authorization checks.
now/block.timestamp used as randomness input, as payout bookkeeping and as the kill() time gate.
Caller-supplied guess (1-16 documented, validated <= 10) passed to play().
Local Game struct instance in play() holding the player address and guessed number before being pushed to gamesPlayed.
Randomness derived from sha3(now, block.blockhash(block.number-1)) — miner/timestamp manipulable.
msg.sender.transfer(this.balance) — sends the entire contract balance to a caller-controlled address.
suicide(msg.sender) — permanently destroys the contract and forwards its balance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into ownerAddr inside the constructor.
msg.sender is assigned to game.player in play().
The number parameter is stored into game.number.
The local Game struct is pushed into the gamesPlayed state array.
play() is publicly callable by any msg.sender.
The guess parameter gates the winning branch that triggers the payout.
The payout sends the full balance to the caller-controlled address msg.sender.
play() executes the balance transfer when the guess matches secretNumber.
An external transfer of ether can invoke the recipient's fallback/callback logic.
The constructor invokes shuffle() to initialize secretNumber.
shuffle() performs the weak-randomness computation.
block.timestamp (now) is fed into the randomness derivation.
The manipulable randomness result is stored into secretNumber.
lastPlayed is set to now at the end of play().
kill() is publicly callable by any msg.sender.
msg.sender must equal ownerAddr for the self-destruct path to run.
The stored ownerAddr is compared against the caller to authorize suicide.
now is used in the lastPlayed + 6 hours condition guarding the suicide.
kill() executes suicide(msg.sender) when its conditions hold.
The fallback is payable and reachable by any caller sending ether.

normalization_plan.reason: The number parameter only exists as an input to play(); it should be merged into the play function node.
The game local variable is a temporary struct used only inside play() before being pushed to gamesPlayed; merge it into the play function node.
